Macros (asm)

Useful sprite-buffer related macros designed to be used in your assembler programs

Macros
cpctm_spriteBufferPtr_asm

Calculates a pointer inside a sprite-buffer based on (X,Y) coordinates relative to the sprite-buffer space, and WIDTH of the sprite-buffer. Calculated pointer is then loaded into a selected 16-bit register

ASM Definition

.macro cpctm_spriteBufferPtr_asm REG16, SPRITE, WIDTH, X, Y

Parameters
REG16

16-bits register where the final result will be loaded

SPRITE

Pointer to the start of the Sprite-Buffer array

WIDTH

Width in bytes of each line of the Sprite-Buffer Array care with this value not to overlap other parts of the code.

X

X coordinate of the point inside the sprite to be calculated

Y

Y coordinate of the point inside the sprite to be calculated

Known limitations:

  • This macro can only be used from assembly programs and files. It is not visible from C scope. For C programs please uses cpctm_spriteBufferPtr.

  • This macro will only work with constant values as parameters. All the calculations must be done in compilation time. If fed with any variable parameter an assembler error will be raised.
